name: Lyo.Web.Automation.FileStorage
tagline: Stores automation step screenshots through a host-configured file storage service.
description: `AddAutomationPlanFileStorage` replaces `IAutomationPlanFileStorage`. The host picks the `IFileStorageService`, including a keyed service. A step screenshot is `image/png` at `Runs/{runId}/steps/{stepId}/{stepId}.png`. Other files use `Runs/{runId}` or `Runs/{runId}/steps/{stepId}`. The file id is returned to the runner.
features: A null save from the default storage leaves the local PNG write in place.

examples.title: Use the workbench file storage service
